title: The Statue of Liberty is in New York. Surrounded by New Jersey.
description:
The Statue of Liberty turns 140 on 28 October 2026. Its island is in New York, but it sits on New Jersey's side of the state line, and Ellis Island next door is in both states.

Sources:
- Frequently Asked Questions — U.S. National Park Service, Statue of Liberty National Monument: https://www.nps.gov/stli/faqs.htm
- Liberty Island: A Chronology — U.S. National Park Service, Statue of Liberty National Monument: https://www.nps.gov/stli/learn/historyculture/liberty-island-a-chronology.htm
- New Jersey v. New York, 523 U.S. 767 (1998) — Supreme Court of the United States, via Cornell Law School Legal Information Institute: https://www.law.cornell.edu/supremecourt/text/523/767
- Liberty Island — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberty_Island
- Statue of Liberty — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statue_of_Liberty

Note: 24.5 acres is the Supreme Court's figure ("some 24.5 acres") for the fill added to Ellis Island after 1891.
